for source in baseline .; do
  cmake -S "$source" -B "$source/build-compat" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCS80_BUILD_PLUGIN=OFF -DCS80_BUILD_TESTS=OFF
  cmake --build "$source/build-compat" --target cs80_core --parallel 2
done
c++ -O2 -std=c++20 -Ibaseline/src src/tools/compatibility_probe.cpp baseline/build-compat/libcs80_core.a -o baseline-probe

exact_frozen_execution_commands.name: Require byte-identical default and noisy-reassignment traces

api_step.name: Require byte-identical default and noisy-reassignment traces

exact_frozen_execution_commands.command:
mkdir -p artifacts/compatibility
corpus=artifacts/compatibility/baseline-corpus.txt
./baseline-probe --export-corpus "$corpus"
corpus_sha256="$(sha256sum "$corpus" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)"
for scenario in default tails; do
  args=()
  if [ "$scenario" = tails ]; then args=(--tails); fi
  ./baseline-probe "artifacts/compatibility/baseline-$scenario.f32" --corpus "$corpus" "${args[@]}"
  ./current-probe "artifacts/compatibility/current-$scenario.f32" --corpus "$corpus" "${args[@]}"
  cmp "artifacts/compatibility/baseline-$scenario.f32" "artifacts/compatibility/current-$scenario.f32"
done
sha256sum "$corpus" artifacts/compatibility/*.f32 > artifacts/compatibility/SHA256SUMS
printf '{"baseline":"%s","candidate":"%s","corpus_source":"%s","corpus_sha256":"%s","corpus_parameters":137,"default_off_byte_identical":true,"legacy_programs":222,"sample_rates":[44100,48000,96000],"analog_evidence":false}\n' "$BASELINE" "$GITHUB_SHA" "$BASELINE" "$corpus_sha256" > artifacts/compatibility/report.json
c++ --version > artifacts/compatibility/compiler.txt
